🏀 PMSoc × SUCE 3x3 Basketball Tournament 🏀

Think you’ve got what it takes? Bring your team, hit the court and battle it out in our 3x3 Basketball Tournament at Perry Park !!

‼️ So many teams signed up for the PMSoc x SUCE Basketball Tournament, that we've booked another court and opened MORE SPOTS 🗣️🗣️

📅 Monday, 12 Oct
📍 Perry Park, Alexandria
⏰ 10:30 AM - 2:30 PM
🏀 Games start at 11:00 AM
💰 $25 per team | $9 individual
🏆 Compete for over $750 worth of prizes !!

Teams will compete in a round-robin format before progressing to knockouts, with games running for 15 minutes or until a team reaches 21 points.

Sportsmanship: Any dissent or disrespect towards referees, staff or other competitors will result in disqualification.

Arrive by 10:45 AM for the briefing.

Limited spots available !! Get your team together and get ready to compete by registering via the link in bio before this SATURDAY🏆

PMSoc’s Biannual Case Competition is back - this time in collaboration with the Project Management Institute !!

Think fast, work together and put your problem-solving skills to the test as you tackle a real-world business challenge and present your recommendations to a panel of industry professionals.

🏆 $500 Prize Pool + Merchandise
🎓 PEP Hours !!
👥 Teams of 3-6
🌏 Open to students from ANY UNIVERSITY - one MUST be enrolled at the University of Sydney
📋 Only one team member needs to register
